content.short: Buy gift cards, eSIMs, flights, hotels and phone top-ups with Bitcoin and stablecoins.
content.description: Running since 2018, Cryptorefills sells more than 6,600 gift cards, eSIMs, mobile top-ups, flights and hotel stays that can be paid for from any wallet or exchange. It accepts BTC on Lightning, USDT, USDC, PYUSD and many other assets across networks including Plasma and World Chain, and delivers most products within seconds. In World App it runs separate mini apps for shopping, flights and hotels.
content.meta: Spend BTC, USDT or USDC on 6,600+ gift cards, eSIMs, flights and hotels with Cryptorefills, delivered in seconds.
